purpose: Compact permanent memory for Black Paint Studio character execution.

identity.hair: black, very long, dense mass first, 3-7 major fringe locks, few selective internal strands
identity.horns: exactly two by default, upper-lateral roots, outward then upward curve, thick base, tapered tip
identity.face: elegant anime adult proportions, tapered jaw, soft chin, expressive eyes, minimal nose and small mouth
identity.outfit: black gothic garment, choker anchor, curved torso silhouette, lace/strap/jewel details
identity.monochrome: face stays mostly white/light, hair/horns/outfit are dominant black masses with sparse gray separation

execution.advance_rule: do not advance past a failed structural checkpoint

negative_rules: no roof or pentagon hair top
no comb-like field of parallel hair lines
no outfit made from horizontal placeholder bars
no 98-100 identity score from contrast/symmetry metrics alone

score_policy.technical_score: global raster quality only; never treated as identity fidelity
score_policy.structural_fidelity: geometry proxy; capped at 90 until a true reference-aware vision model exists
